Setup and Configuration

Setup and Configuration

How to install and configure Six Solution Template in your project

Introduction

Section titled “Introduction”

The Six Solution Template provides an automated setup process that handles all the initial configuration tasks, making it easy to get started with your new project.

Prerequisites

Section titled “Prerequisites”

Before running the setup, ensure you have the following tools installed:

🔧 .NET 10 SDK

Required Tool

Section titled “Required Tool”
  • Download: dotnet.microsoft.com/download
  • Purpose: Builds and runs .NET projects, executes C# scripts
  • Verification: Run dotnet --version to check installation

📦 Package Managers

Choose One

Section titled “Choose One”

pnpm (Recommended)

Section titled “pnpm (Recommended)”
  • Install: npm install -g pnpm
  • Advantages: Faster, disk-efficient, better dependency management
  • Website: pnpm.io

npm (Alternative)

Section titled “npm (Alternative)”
  • Included with: Node.js
  • Verification: Run npm --version to check installation

Quick Start

Section titled “Quick Start”

After cloning the repository, run the automated setup from the solution root directory:

The setup script will:

  1. ✅ Check all prerequisites
  2. 🔄 Restore .NET NuGet packages
  3. 📦 Install documentation dependencies
  4. ⚙️ Guide you through configuration
  5. 📝 Update project files automatically

Automated Setup Process

Section titled “Automated Setup Process”

  1. Prerequisites Check The setup automatically verifies:

    • dotnet CLI availability and version
    • pnpm or npm installation
    • Solution file detection (.slnx or .sln)

  2. Package Restoration Automatically runs dotnet restore to restore all NuGet packages for the solution.

  3. Documentation Dependencies Node packages needed for documentation are automatically installed using pnpm or npm in the docs directory.

  4. Interactive Configuration The setup guides you through configuring your project with optional prompts:

    NuGet Package Configuration:

    • GitHub Repository URL
    • Package authors and copyright
    • Project description and URLs

    Documentation Configuration:

    • GitHub Pages URL and site title

    Note: All configuration fields are optional. Press Enter to skip and keep default values.

  5. Automatic File Updates The setup automatically updates:

    • libs/Directory.Build.props: NuGet package metadata and repository information
    • docs/astro.config.mjs: Site configuration and GitHub Pages settings

Troubleshooting

Section titled “Troubleshooting”

.NET CLI Not Found

Section titled “.NET CLI Not Found”

Solution: Install .NET 10 SDK from dotnet.microsoft.com

No Package Manager Found

Section titled “No Package Manager Found”

Solution: Install Node.js (includes npm) from nodejs.org or pnpm with npm install -g pnpm

Solution File Not Found

Section titled “Solution File Not Found”

Solution: Ensure you’re running the setup from the repository root directory containing .sln or .slnx files

Package Installation Failures

Section titled “Package Installation Failures”

If package installation fails:

  1. Check your internet connection
  2. Verify Node.js version compatibility
  3. Try clearing package manager caches:
